scenario: A commercial property & casualty insurer's loss-control engineering team conducts an annual on-site hazard inspection at an insured industrial facility (warehouse, food-processing plant, metal-fab shop). Inspector notes and facility-parameter data are loaded from CSV, findings are classified by hazard severity and frequency using a policy-driven auditor, and the results are compiled into a loss-control report delivered to the underwriting team to drive renewal and premium decisions.
info_flow: csv-pipeline reads inspector_notes.csv and facility_params.csv, normalizes findings, and outputs a structured JSON payload with raw finding records → presale-regulation-auditor receives the finding records, applies its risk-class scoring rules to each hazard, and produces a classified findings table with severity labels and remediation status → ub2-markdown-report-generator compiles the classified table into the formal loss-control report with an executive summary and recommendations section.
